Your device will then create a small amount of vapour for an MTL (Mouth To Lung) vape that feels like a cigarette. The built-in mesh coils will heat up your e-liquid faster for improved flavour and you won’t need to worry about messy coil changes either, as you can just replace the entire pod instead.
